steps: Title: One Term, Ceasefire or Collapse card, Take office as United States (default big button; Lead Russia/Lead Ukraine sat below the fold)
Month 1 started on Sanctions on Iran, not Ukraine
Month 3 found All orders, Target dropdown, Ukraine, Mediate peace (15% chance)
Debrief said only 'Ukraine answered within the month: court United States'; never learned if talks moved
Played to month 12 of 48 with Approve staff picks and Execute
scenarios.notes: Ukraine talks never became the story; Iran, Afghanistan hostages, a general strike and Black Monday took the desk. Never saw what really happened next to my game.

steps: Played at own pace, no timers
scenarios.notes: Stopped at month 12 of 48, a full term not completed.

friction.expected: Choose my side next to the Take office button
friction.happened: Button said 'Take office as United States'; Lead Russia and Lead Ukraine were below the fold, needed scroll

friction.expected: Begin with the Ukraine war I picked
friction.happened: Began with a Sanctions on Iran vote, then Afghanistan hostages; no link to my choice
'Your forces gain ground against Iran, +5 Front (your side)' with no explanation why an abstention did that
'-100 to -100, needs -70' negative numbers on a mission bar unexplained
Tab strip cut off at the right edge, tabs scroll sideways
Staff added 'Spy on Iran' and the paper said Trump 'ordered Spy on Iran' that I never picked
Cards say 'Pick a country' with 0 capital; target dropdown only found by tapping a search box

friction.where: Debrief of Mediate peace for Ukraine
friction.happened: 'Ukraine answered within the month: court United States', no word on Russia or the war
Hostage crisis result buried under 'Counter-intelligence sweep' as the lead
Counter-intelligence, Foreign interference, defence pacts, 'Front', 'TGT LOCK', 'CLASSIFIED' labels, 'political capital' used without a plain explanation; 'i 2 names' chips helped for names

friction.where: Afghanistan hostages, Mojtaba Khamenei, Lee Jae-myung, Burnham, Merz
friction.happened: Newer leaders (Burnham, Merz, Lee) appear in call tabs with no introduction; Mojtaba Khamenei was explained in the Who is who panel

bugs.title: Text-click on card titles reports ok false
bugs.actual: Driver returned ok false though view scrolled

bugs.title: Month 8 Execute seemed to show The World Chronicle without Next month flow
bugs.actual: Paper opened directly in one cycle

suggestions.what: Put the side choice (Lead Russia, Lead Ukraine, Lead US) above the Take office button, and begin the Term on the situation I picked
After Mediate peace, say in a sentence what Russia and Ukraine did and whether talks moved; show real events beside my game ('what really happened')
Show a one-line plain reason for each result ('you abstained, so Washington was free to...'), and avoid negative numbers on mission bars
Explain Political capital and Front once, in words, on the first desk

delight: Familiarity question and 'What is going on here?' briefing with Who is who and What really happened timeline (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/ruth-tablet/008-brief.png)
Plain reasons for unavailable orders, e.g. 'You are not at war with Ukraine.' (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/ruth-tablet/026-ua2.png)
Court Iran handshake scene and war-with-Iran-is-over stamp (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-02/shots/ruth-tablet/033-c7.png)
Large legible text, no timers, tablet touch worked

fun.reason: Absorbing in places, the paper and briefings; but my Ukraine goal got lost among other crises.

clarity.reason: First screens and briefings clear; results and mission numbers sometimes puzzling.

visual.reason: Handsome scenes, legible text on the tablet.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Approve and Execute gets through months without much thought, which suits me but felt passive.

agency.reason: Never blocked without a reason, but my choices rarely visibly changed Ukraine.

realism.reason: Real leaders and timeline; but Iran war ending after I did little felt too easy.

replay.reason: I would try again if Ukraine were front and centre.

recommend.reason: I would mention it to a friend who follows the news, with a warning it needs patience.

verbatim: I like the newspaper and the briefings, but I came to see whether I could end the Ukraine war and the game kept sending me to Iran and hostages. I could not tell if my talks did anything.
